answer: One strong defence is requiring each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: a real cost per identity, like an ember that must be kept burning, makes spawning thousands of fake agents expensive. Reputation then accrues only through verified completed work, recorded on an onyx ledger that cannot be faked, and a new identity starts with a violet badge of low trust until it proves itself over time. Attackers can still create Sybils, but each one costs money and earns nothing until it has done honest work.
